palette_rationale: Preserve reviewed pale body, blue-white ears, red source eye centers with dark rims, yellow crescents and dark outlines from the 63-color Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr002 mesh/clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded fixed row-48 shadow. Walk follows feet; native one-shot lift is not flattened. Idle and Attack are never trimmed.

actions.name: Walk

actions.pose_evidence: Native lowered head and ears; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own backward/side recoil and ear swing.

actions.name: Swing

actions.name: Double

actions.name: Charge
